outcome: maternal need for support during breastfeeding
cohort: The study participants were 113 pregnant women who were candidates for cesarean section.
finding: Oketani breast massage significantly improved breastfeeding success, reduced the need for support, increased breastfeeding sessions, shortened feeding intervals, and boosted breastfeeding self-efficacy in mothers undergoing cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Oketani massage improved breastfeeding outcomes, including success rate and self-efficacy, in mothers who underwent cesarean sections, directly addressing a known negative effect of this birth mode.
